## 1. Executive Summary

The flagship was assessed with nikto, nmap, nuclei, ffuf, wpscan and httpx.
The estate's edge is a Cloudflare-proxied stack (HTTP/3 advertised, cf-ray
present) — an already hardened perimeter. 21 items were flagged, dominated by
**five missing security headers** and standard Cloudflare-presence notices.
No service-level vulnerabilities were identified. Exposure posture:
**low-risk; routine hardening recommended.**

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Findings | 21 |
| Security-header gaps | 5 (all fixable in one nginx pass) |
| Critical / High | 0 |
| Edge protection | Cloudflare (filtered ports, HTTP/3, cf-ray) |
| Overall | REVIEW → CLEAN after header hardening |

## 2. Key Findings

1. **Missing Security Headers (5)** — `strict-transport-security`,
   `content-security-policy`, `x-content-type-options`, `referrer-policy`,
   `permissions-policy`. *Impact:* weakened clickjacking/XSS/MIME-typing
   resistance, no HSTS guarantee. *Fix:* one nginx snippet (in the estate kit:
   `nginx-security-headers.conf`), then re-scan to prove green.
2. **Cloudflare edge confirmed** — cf-ray + alt-svc (HTTP/3) on `:443`.
   *Posture:* perimeter proxied and filtered — intended architecture.
3. **Content discovery** — `index.html` returned by ffuf on the target root;
   no additional exposed paths surfaced.
